text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — Cypress asked to run a short POC next week. They want to validate a custom LLM (cypress-30b-v2) for clinical summarization. Key asks: secure hosting (can be private/VPC), KMS-managed keys, model variant with quantized weights, KV cache for long context, and p95 latency target ~300ms for 2k-token prompts. Also they sent a security questionnaire and want a cost estimate for a 6-week trial.
Diego Ramos: Thanks. Do we have sample prompts / avg seq len? generation vs embed?
Maya Chen: Mostly generation, avg input ~1.5k tokens, outputs ~250 tokens. A few longer transcripts up to 4k. I'll drop sample dataset link: <link-to-samples>. They flagged hallucination risk and want quality/regression checks.
Diego Ramos: OK. For 4k contexts we should verify tokenizer and rope scaling. Recommend trying cypress-30b-v2-int8-kv (experimental) and a fallback cypress-13b-slim for latency-sensitive routes. Need to run a quick tokenizer diff: sometimes eos_id/pad mismatch causes truncation.
Omar Singh: Pricing note: for a short POC we can offer a timebound Dedicated pool (2x A100-80GB) + burst into hosted. Ballpark commit/credit deal for 6 weeks, we can lean on discounted reserved capacity — I'll draft numbers after we size expected token volume.
Ruth Patel: On infra: KV cache for 4k+ contexts will increase GPU RAM — int8 helps but KV shards matter. If we do interleaved kv layout + prefix caching we can hit latency target more easily. One caveat: cypress-30b-v2 uses RMSNorm; our Triton path lacks a fused RMSNorm kernel so we might run a slower fallback unless we use the XLA path. Need perf run.
Jae Kim: Legal flag — Cypress requires SOC2 + DPA, per-customer KMS controls, and answers to the 56-item security questionnaire. They asked about data retention defaults and ability to disable logs for PII. I need the security questionnaire filled to start legal review.
Maya Chen: I'll attach the questionnaire in the thread. Also Cypress prefers on-prem for PHI if possible; we asked whether Redwood Private on their VPC is feasible for the POC.
Diego Ramos: Private should be doable but needs install window. For a fast POC: suggest start hosted with dedicated GPU pool + VPC peering for secure egress, then timeline to bring Private in parallel. I'll run a model-compat check against our catalog.
infra-bot: Ticket created: #POC-6124 — "Cypress cypress-30b-v2 POC: sizing, security, perf". Assigned: eng-runtime, sales-eng. Link: <internal-ticket/POC-6124>.
Ruth Patel: I'll queue two perf jobs: (1) int8 KV run with 2k/4k traces, (2) baseline fp16 run. Need the model artifact or HF path.
Maya Chen: HF path: hf://cypress/cypress-30b-v2 (they granted access).
Diego Ramos: Quick compatibility runbook snippet for SEs: 
```
# inspect model
redwoodctl model inspect --model hf://cypress/cypress-30b-v2
# quick perf
redwoodctl perf run --model cypress-30b-v2 --quant int8 --kv interleaved --seq-len 4096 --batch 1
```
Diego Ramos: Also check tokenizer: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json').encode('example'))"` — verify eos/pad ids match our serving runtime.
Omar Singh: Recommend routing plan: canary on 10% traffic to the 30b-int8 cluster, fallback to 13b-slim for requests over 300ms. We'll need a canary route in the console.
Ruth Patel: I'll provision a small Dedicated pool: 2x A100-80GB for the POC window, and enable prefix/KV caching. If we hit memory pressure, we can turn on kv-pruning (LRU) at the routing layer.
Jae Kim: I'll start the legal queue once we have the filled questionnaire and confirmation we can support KMS-managed keys with customer bring-your-own-key. Also confirm SOC2 artifacts and subprocessor list.
Maya Chen: Great. Next steps from my side: attach questionnaire, share sample prompts, and schedule an alignment call with Cypress for Wed 10am PT. Can Sales Eng / SEs prepare the perf results and a pricing note by EOD Tue?
Diego Ramos: Will run perf jobs today and share logs.
Omar Singh: I'll put together a 6-week POC pricing sketch + Dedicated commit options and post by EOD Tue.
Ruth Patel: I'll upload perf traces + perf summary to the ticket once runs finish.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: — adding Cypress contacts to the thread and linking the meeting invite.
